name: La-Z-Boy
verdict: WATCH 5/10 (independent court 2026-07-29; two-mode, FY26 10-K primary). Fair-not-deep CONFIRMED: spot sits ON base FV. Not TINA-quality - revenue +22% vs FY19 with EBIT exactly FLAT ($129.7M->$129.2M; 7 years of reinvestment bought zero incremental EBIT; a capital-recycling machine converting wholesale into company-owned retail, 230/378 stores) - so fair value is NOT the entry; the case pays only at a discount or on the demand turn. Stabilization real: EBIT decline flattening (-29/-10/-5%), Q4 adj margin +50bps, written +11% Q4 (store-count-driven; written SSS -2% = underlying demand still negative), April strongest + positive trends into May; casegoods divested, UK restructured; NEW $300M buyback = 18% of mkt cap, ~6% total shareholder yield.
fv_note: 8-10x adj EBIT (~$151M) no-growth basis; bear = deeper trough EBIT $95-105M at 9-10x, bounded by cash+buyback; bull = housing normalization $180-200M EBIT - real but untimeable
screen_corrections: sev 5: 'NET CASH' is financial-debt-only - operating leases $562M AND RISING (488->562 FY26, the leased retail expansion = a fixed-cost ratchet); lease-adjusted ~$260M net DEBT, EV ~$1.9B, ~8.3x EV/(EBIT+rent). sev 4: 'decelerating not collapsing' = generous history (GAAP EBIT 211->151->136->129, -39% over 3yrs), fair present (flattening). Honesty grade on our own screen: REVIEW.
